_doc: The only source of randomness seeds (brief, pre-production step 8). Every random process reads its seed from here by name; scripts/check_seeds.sh confirms a re-run reproduces its frames exactly. The main video uses 41.

swarm_placement.used_by: set G: 700 probes' seat jitter and idle LED phase

pellet_scatter.used_by: pellet launch jitter of +-1 frame where a stream would look mechanical (arrival never moves)

token_rain.used_by: set H: key candles' flicker phase

analysis.used_by: style measurements (k-means), drum NMF free components, calibration onsets
